notes: A month you have reconciled can now be opened again. Reconcile January, and once the bank pays January's cheques in February, setting the statement date back to 31 January used to show none of them — the screen was asking what is outstanding NOW, and a presented cheque left that answer for every date, including the dates on which it really was outstanding. So a month stopped being reproducible at exactly the moment you finished it. The reconciliation now asks as at its own statement date, and cheques presented later, lodgements credited later, and cheques reinstated or cancelled later each come back into the month they belonged to and leave on the day they actually cleared. A signed-off month opens too: History has an Open button on every row, one click puts that month back on screen with its own figures ready for Print / PDF and Export Excel, it says who signed it and when, and it tells you if the register has moved since it was filed. Re-opening a signed-off month now says in words that that is what it does, instead of the only working button quietly taking a filed record back to DRAFT. The Cheque Register gains a search box over cheque number, payee, amount, note, reference and payer — amounts match as typed or as displayed — and Issued/Date now sort both ways; the register was also listing its oldest outstanding cheques at the bottom, under a column headed Issued. Existing books upgrade in place; no posting rule, report or figure has changed.
